correctness.rationale: For every fixed tree, source/sink indicator pairs have joint factor x_u x_v except at shared edges, where they have factor 2; same-type adjacent pairs are impossible. Weighted Prüfer enumeration yields exact E[x_u], E[x_u x_v], and marked-edge expectation b_n/[4(n-1)], giving all second moments. The inequality (1-1/(2n))^2>1-1/n proves the strict sign for n>=3; the path calculation and logarithmic asymptotics give the other stated conclusions. The standalone finite verifier executed 70 checks; its finite scope is explicitly separate from the analytic proof.

Accessible prior mathematical claims were compared, but historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: Two canonical and structurally related DAG statistics exhibit a sharp, exact, all-size negative correlation when shape is random, while fixed long paths have positive conditional covariance. The all-size strict sign, complete second-moment formulas, and a nonzero limiting correlation quantify a meaningful annealed/quenched distinction not implied by generic connectivity inequalities; this is useful as a benchmark for probabilistic tree orientations.
